name: Cam sanh
summary: Cam sành from the organic cooperative at Quảng Phú in Krong No, rated 4 stars in the provincial OCOP scheme. You taste the fruit in the garden, which has taken visitors since 2022.
origin: The Dak Nong tourism portal’s article on OCOP products and rural tourism.
howToEat: The portal says cam sành and quýt đường from Hợp tác xã Sản xuất nông lâm nghiệp hữu cơ Quảng Phú hold a provincial OCOP rank of 4 stars, and that guests taste the clean fruit in the garden.
where: Quảng Phú, Krong No. The portal says the cooperative has welcomed visitors for garden visits since 2022.
seoTitle: Cam sanh in Dak Nong — Quang Phu OCOP fruit
seoDescription: Cam sành from Quảng Phú in Krong No, a 4-star provincial OCOP fruit guests taste in the garden.
